policy: Externally hosted, open-weight agricultural models. AgML does not host, download, or redistribute these weights, and has NOT benchmarked them: every metric below is copied from the cited source and is unverified by AgML. These results are kept separate from the AgML leaderboard and are not comparable to it.

models.name: Prithvi-EO-1.0-100M Multi-Temporal Crop Classification
models.summary: Geospatial foundation model (Prithvi-EO-1.0-100M, a temporal ViT/MAE) fine-tuned to map crop and land-cover types across the contiguous US from three time steps of 6-band Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel (HLS) imagery, using USDA Cropland Data Layer labels.

reported_results.split: held-out validation chips (per model card config)
reported_results.notes: 13 classes. Per-class IoU ranges from 0.3084 (Alfalfa) to 0.6804 (Open Water); Corn 0.5491, Soybeans 0.5297, Winter Wheat 0.4967, Cotton 0.3237, Sorghum 0.3283. The card notes CDL labels are noisy, which caps achievable scores.
reported_results.source: Hugging Face model card, Results table

datasets.name: HLS Multi-Temporal Crop Classification (HLS + USDA CDL)
datasets.description: 224×224 chips of Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel imagery over the contiguous US, 3 time steps × 6 bands (Blue, Green, Red, Narrow NIR, SWIR 1, SWIR 2) = 18 channels, labelled with 13 crop / land-cover classes from the USDA Cropland Data Layer.

reproduction.notes: Fine-tuning code and the exact mmseg config are public; the card reports an 80-epoch run with that config. A separate baseline (non-foundation) model is published by Clark CGA.

models.strong_use_cases: US-scale crop-type / land-cover mapping from HLS time series; a starting point to fine-tune for regional crop mapping with better labels.
models.limitations: Requires 18-band HLS GeoTIFF input (3 dates). Trained on noisy CDL labels; modest per-class IoU for minor crops. US only.
models.citation: Li, H. et al. (2023). HLS Multi Temporal Crop Classification Model. Hugging Face. doi:10.57967/hf/0954

models.architecture: CLIP ViT-B/16 image encoder + text transformer (initialised from OpenAI CLIP)

reported_results.notes: OpenAI CLIP baseline: 58.5.

models.name: DeepWeeds ResNet-50 / Inception-v3

models.summary: Baseline CNN classifiers released with the DeepWeeds dataset for identifying eight invasive weed species (plus a negative class) in Australian rangeland imagery from a ground robot camera.

models.strong_use_cases: Rangeland weed species ID from ground-vehicle imagery; a well-documented baseline to compare against on an AgML-hosted dataset.

models.name: DeepForest Tree Crown Detector
models.summary: Prebuilt RGB airborne tree-crown detector from the DeepForest Python package. Trained semi-supervised: millions of LiDAR-derived pseudo-labels, then hand annotations of RGB imagery from selected NEON sites.

reported_results.notes: IoU threshold not stated in the scores table (DeepForest's evaluation default is 0.4). The same table reports recall 0.61 on field-annotated crowns and 0.74 on field-collected stems.
reported_results.source: NeonTreeEvaluation R package README, scores table

datasets.name: NeonTreeEvaluation benchmark
datasets.description: Hand-annotated tree crowns on 40 m × 40 m NEON airborne RGB images (10 cm) across 22 US NEON sites (30,975 annotations), with co-registered LiDAR and hyperspectral data. CC0.

agml.note: AgML's niwo_tree_crown_detection is a different NEON-derived dataset (NIWO site, Harmon 2024), not this benchmark.

datasets.name: NEON LiDAR-derived pseudo-labels + hand-annotated RGB crowns
datasets.description: Millions of moderate-quality crown boxes generated by an unsupervised LiDAR tree detection algorithm, then refined with hand annotations of RGB imagery from selected NEON sites.

agml.note: Pretraining labels are not released as a standalone dataset.

reproduction.notes: Evaluation via the NeonTreeEvaluation R package; the model loads in one line with the deepforest Python package.
commands: python -c "from deepforest import main; m = main.deepforest(); m.load_model('weecology/deepforest-tree')"

models.strong_use_cases: Counting / delineating tree crowns in ~10 cm aerial or UAV RGB imagery (orchards, agroforestry, forests) as a starting point for fine-tuning.
models.limitations: Tuned to ~10 cm NEON imagery; resolution mismatch degrades results. Forest-oriented training sites.
models.citation: Weinstein, B. et al. (2020). DeepForest: A Python package for RGB deep learning tree crown delineation. Methods in Ecology and Evolution 11, 1743–1751.

models.name: Pl@ntNet-300K Baseline CNNs
models.summary: ImageNet-pretrained CNN/ViT baselines (ResNet, DenseNet, EfficientNet, ViT, etc.) fine-tuned for 1,081-species plant identification on the long-tailed Pl@ntNet-300K dataset.
models.architecture: ResNet-18/50, DenseNet, EfficientNet, ViT and others (one checkpoint per architecture)

reported_results.notes: Test accuracy binned by number of training images per class (paper Table 1). Headline top-1 / macro-average top-1 for all architectures are shown only as figures (Fig. 5, 8); macro-average top-1 stays below 40% for every model, which shows how hard the long tail is.

datasets.name: Pl@ntNet-300K
datasets.description: 306,146 citizen-science plant photos of 1,081 species (train 243,916 / val 31,118 / test 31,112), strongly long-tailed: 80% of species have 11% of the images. Use v1.1.

reproduction.notes: Training script and per-model hyperparameters (supplementary material) are public; dataset on Zenodo.

models.strong_use_cases: Plant species ID backbones; studying long-tail and set-valued (average-k) prediction.
models.limitations: Weights license is not stated; check with the authors before redistributing. Weak on rare species.
models.citation: Garcin, C. et al. (2021). Pl@ntNet-300K: a plant image dataset with high label ambiguity and a long-tailed distribution. NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks.

models.name: PlantCLEF 2024 DINOv2 ViT-B/14 (Pl@ntNet)

models.limitations: No published single-image accuracy on the landing page. The challenge task is multi-label quadrat images, which is a different setting.

datasets.name: CropAndWeed
datasets.description: 8,034 top-down images (~1.1 m height) from 929 sessions at Austrian farms and plots, ~112k instances of 74 species (16 crops, 58 weeds) with boxes, semantic masks and stem positions (Steininger et al., WACV 2023).

reproduction.notes: Full augmentation and optimizer settings on the card; dataset public.

models.strong_use_cases: Crop-vs-weed detection for row-crop robots in European fields.
models.limitations: Only precision reported; AGPL license.
models.citation: NvMayMay (2026). weedblaster-vision-yolov8s. Hugging Face. Dataset: Steininger, D. et al. (2023) CropAndWeed, WACV.

models.name: Grassland Weeds YOLO (dock, cow parsley, nettle, thistle)
models.summary: Family of Ultralytics YOLO detection and segmentation models for four grassland / pasture weeds from smartphone photos, with a careful card (validation-set fingerprints, per-class results, limitations).

reported_results.notes: Small validation set (e.g. 4 cow-parsley instances), so per-class numbers are noisy.
Mask metrics; box mAP@50 of the seg model 0.825.

datasets.name: Grassland weeds (custom smartphone set)
datasets.description: Full-resolution Google Pixel photos of dock, cow parsley, stinging nettle and thistle in grassland, polygon-labelled per species, plus 237 dock images exported from Roboflow.

agml.note: Not released.

reproduction.notes: Training script and split fingerprints described on the card; data not released.
commands: yolo predict model=grassland_weedsV1.pt source=path/to/images imgsz=640 conf=0.25

models.strong_use_cases: Pasture weed spotting (dock, thistle) for spot-spraying.
models.limitations: Small private dataset; AGPL.
models.citation: JacobsFarmextra (2026). grassland_weeds. Hugging Face.

models.name: YOLOv8 Tomato Ripeness Detector (greenhouse)
models.summary: YOLOv8n/s detecting greenhouse tomatoes in three ripeness stages (unripe, semi-ripe, fully ripe), with an OpenVINO INT8 export and RealSense 3D localization code.

datasets.name: Greenhouse tomato ripeness (three public sources, unified in Roboflow)
datasets.description: Greenhouse tomato images from three public sources, re-annotated with boxes for unripe / semi-ripe / fully ripe.

agml.note: Related tomato ripeness detection data exists in AgML; the card doesn't name its three sources.

reproduction.notes: GitHub repo includes ROS / RealSense deployment.

models.strong_use_cases: Harvest-robot ripeness detection in greenhouses on CPU (OpenVINO).
models.limitations: Sources unnamed; split undocumented.
models.citation: pablofntdz (2026). yolov8-tomato-detection. Hugging Face.

models.name: Maize Leaf Disease CNN (4 classes)
models.summary: TensorFlow CNN classifying maize leaves as healthy, gray leaf spot, blight or common rust, trained on the Kaggle corn/maize leaf disease set derived from PlantVillage and PlantDoc.

datasets.name: Corn or Maize Leaf Disease Dataset (Kaggle)
datasets.description: 4,188 maize leaf images from PlantVillage and PlantDoc: Common Rust 1,306, Gray Leaf Spot 574, Blight 1,146, Healthy 1,162.

agml.note: Same 4,188-image dataset.

reproduction.notes: Colab inference notebook; no metrics or training details.

models.strong_use_cases: Simple maize disease classifier trained on the same images as AgML's corn_maize_leaf_disease.
models.limitations: No reported accuracy.
models.citation: eligapris (2024). maize-diseases-detection. Hugging Face.

models.name: LeafMachine3 leaf / petiole / hole segmenter (YOLO26x-seg)
models.summary: Instance segmentation of leaves, petioles and holes on single-leaf crops at 1024 px, for automated leaf trait measurement (area, shape, damage) in the LeafMachine pipeline.

reported_results.notes: Mask metrics. Test mask AP50 per class: Leaf 0.932, Petiole 0.827, Hole 0.432. Box mAP50 0.751.

datasets.name: LM3_Leaf
datasets.description: 16,895 single-leaf crops from 5 Labelbox segmentation projects (herbarium / leaf imagery), labelled leaf, petiole and hole.

agml.note: Images and labels are not distributed.

reproduction.notes: Evaluation metrics file in the repo; data not released.

models.strong_use_cases: Leaf area / herbivory (hole) measurement from cropped leaf images.
models.limitations: Hole class weak (AP50 0.43); trained on herbarium-style crops.
models.citation: Weaver, W. (2026). LeafMachine3 leaf segmenter. Hugging Face.

models.name: FODUU Plant Leaf Detection & Classification (YOLOv8s)
models.summary: YOLOv8s that detects leaves and classifies them by plant species across ~40 crops and ornamentals (ginger, banana, tobacco, rose, soybean, papaya, mango, cotton, corn, …).

reported_results.notes: Card calls this 'precision (mAP@0.5)'; no dataset or split details.

datasets.name: FODUU leaf dataset (undisclosed)
datasets.description: Leaf images of ~40 plant species; the card does not describe sources, size or split.

agml.note: Not released.

reproduction.notes: Inference snippet only.

models.strong_use_cases: Rough leaf localization + species tag across many crops (36 likes on the Hub).
models.limitations: Undisclosed data; no license; old Ultralytics version.
models.citation: FODUU AI (2023). plant-leaf-detection-and-classification. Hugging Face.
